Hello,

My name is Matthew G. McClosky, and I am the Internet Sales Manager for Scientific

I was researching companies and individuals using the search term "Statistical

Our May editorial focusing is Statistical Software, and I thought you would you be 
interested in advertising your software or company with a banner on our website 
http://www.scimag.com or in one of our bi-monthly email newsletters?  

Email Newsletter:
http://www.mcclosky.net/science/email/SCI.htm
SCI Weekly, is the primary source for the latest product and company news in

mathematics, statistics, visualization, data analysis, chemistry, spectroscopy and 
more.

Web Site: 
http://www.scimag.com  
Our web site with over 60,000 page impressions per month contains the latest SC&I
